sentences.text: 4 07-10-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in Mahila P.S. Case No. 13 of 2024 registered under Sections 323, 324, 354, 354(B), 147, 149, 366, 366(A), 376, 511, 506 of the Indian Penal Code and 12 of the POCSO Act.
3. Allegedly, the accused persons are said to have molested the victim and her elder sister.

It is also alleged that the accused persons assaulted the mother of the victim, for which, another case i.e.
Sarairanjan P.S. Case No. 343 of 2023 has been Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.30195 of 2025(4)
dt.07-10-2025 registered.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners are innocent and they have Vidya Sagar Chourasiya vs The State Of Bihar on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75309573/
1 falsely been implicated in this case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He submitted further that the police has recovered a bottle of wine from the house of the informant/complainant and the same was informed by the petitioner No.
1 and his family members, and that is why, he has falsely been made accused in the present case.
It has further been submitted that so far as petitioner No. 2 is concerned, he is not named in the FIR.

5. On the otherhand, learned counsel for the informant has submitted that prior to lodging of the present case, the petitioner No. 1 had outraged the modesty of elder sister of the informant/complainant and when her elder sister protested, the petitioner No. 1 stabbed her who became injured and for that occurrence, Sarairanjan P.S. Case No. 343 of 2023 was lodged on the basis of information given by the elder sister of the informant/complainant.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the petitioner No. 2, above named, in the event of arrest/surrender before the learned court below within a period of four weeks, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.30195 of 2025(4)
dt.07-10-2025 bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-VI-cum-Spl. Court (POCSO), Samastipur in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 13 of 2024, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
7. So far as the petitioner No. 1 is concerned, considering the allegation made against him, he does not deserve the privilege of anticipatory bail and accordingly, the same is rejected.

( Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) A.K.V.//-
